Data engineering:

```{r}
cre_sf <- st_read("../data/processed/london_cre_2023_spatial.gpkg", quiet = TRUE)
city_center <- st_sfc(st_point(c(-0.0886, 51.5145)), crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
cre_unique <- cre_sf %>%
  group_by(postcode) %>%
  summarize(median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(log_price = log(median_price)) %>%
  st_jitter(amount = 0.0001)
```

```{r}
cre_unique$dist_to_center <- as.numeric(st_distance(cre_unique, city_center))
buffer_zones <- st_buffer(cre_unique, dist = 1000)
cre_unique$local_density <- lengths(st_intersects(cre_unique, buffer_zones))
```

```{r}
cre_multivariate <- cre_unique %>%
  rename(
    Value = log_price,
    Centrality = dist_to_center,
    Liquidity = local_density
  )
```

Safety checks on out 3-variate dataset.

```{r}
library(moments)
kurtosis_results <- cre_multivariate %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%  
  select(Value, Centrality, Liquidity) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ kurtosis(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

print(kurtosis_results)
```

Save the dataset:

```{r}
final_data_path <- "../data/processed/londonCRE.gpkg"
st_write(cre_multivariate, final_data_path, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```
